_comment: Expectations for the corpus harness (see tests/corpus/README.md).
Counts, versions, flags and hashes only; no Bethesda content. Each install is
enabled by the environment variable in 'env' and skipped when it is unset.
'file_bytes': plugin size on disk. Only changes when the game is patched.
'shadowed': virtual paths provided by more than one archive (as 'bethconv scan').
'expected_read_failures': entries corrupt in the shipped archive, pinned both
ways (a new failure is a regression; a success means a different install).
'textures': a few real surfaces per install covering every branch, with an
FNV-1a over the texture pass output.
'load_order': where the folder-based ordering places each plugin and in which
index space.
'merge': totals, an FNV-1a over merged per-type counts, and one form per merge
class (override, deletion, injection, parented record, light space).
'merge' also pins world.fb written from the merged world: its counts and an
FNV-1a over its bytes.
'forms': field definitions over the plugins above. 'leftover' must be zero;
'unhandled' and 'unhandled_hash' track undecoded fields; 'string_tables'
guards 'unresolved_strings'.
'convert': two filtered runs per install ('every-kind', 'spaced-texture-slots')
with FNV-1a hashes of the bookkeeping files; emitted glTF JSON must have no
control bytes and must parse strictly. Each run's 'view' pins the pack read
back through vpath.idx. Two more ('terrain-lod', 'tree-lod') cover LOD.
Regenerate with: bethconv-corpus-snapshot > tests/corpus/corpus-expectations.json
